text: \Olref{Valphabasicprops} gives one direction. Conversely, suppose $V_\alpha \in V_\beta$. Then $\alpha \neq \beta$ by \olref{Valphanotref}; and $\beta \notin \alpha$, for otherwise we would have $V_\beta \in V_\alpha$ and hence $V_\beta \in V_\beta$ by \olref{Valphabasicprops} (twice), contradicting \olref{Valphanotref}. So $\alpha \in \beta$ by Trichotomy.
